entries.speaker: Skill Inheritance
entries.en: When fusing a new Persona, some skills from[n]the component Personas may be inherited by[n]the new one.

entries.speaker: Skill Inheritance
entries.en: Which skills can be inherited depend on the[n]Persona being fused. [clr 2]The more skills the[n]component Personas have, the more skills can[n]be inherited.[clr 27]
